# Meeks Cafe

> Soul Food Restaurant in San Antonio, Texas. Breaded fried pork ribs, wings, chops and catfish from the truck on North Foster Road.

- Phone: (210) 429-3158
- Address: 5578 N Foster Rd, San Antonio, TX 78244
- Areas: San Antonio, Converse, Schertz, Boerne, New Braunfels
- Offers: Fried ribs and wings; Pork chops and catfish; Sides from scratch
- Rating: 4.5 from 54 Google reviews
